card.name: Auxiliary verbs before "been reported"
card.fires_on: Helper verbs such as has, have, also and been right before a past participle like reported or occurred, in adverse-event sentences in drug labels. A few cases are linking words like from in list titles.

modes.label: Have/has been reported
modes.description: The helper verb or the word also or been sits just before "reported" after a condition or event.
modes.example: Autoimmune disorders (such as Graves' disease, polymyositis, and Guillain-BarrÉ syndrome) have also<< been>> reported to occur in the setting of immune

modes.label: Verb after event noun
modes.description: A helper verb follows an adverse event noun and precedes been reported or occurred.
modes.example: Life threatening events and fatal outcomes associated with hypocalcemia<< have>> been reported in patients treated with cinac

modes.label: Linking word in title
modes.description: A linking word such as from in a list of web page titles.
modes.example: Top 10 Classroom Organization Tips<< from>> Veteran Teachers to Top 10 Free
